summary.text: Sarah Eckhardt, a Democrat from Austin, represents Texas Senate District 14 and was elected to the Senate for Travis County in July 2020. Before the Senate she served as Travis County Judge from 2015 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Eckhardt received a Master of Public Affairs from the LBJ School and a law degree from the University of Texas at Austin in 1998.
She worked for eight years as an Assistant Travis County Attorney and served as Travis County Commissioner from 2006 to 2013.
Her parents were Congressman Bob Eckhardt and Nadine Eckhardt, and she has a son and a daughter.
